{{Recipe}}

Cinnamon buns are another name for cinnamon rolls. These sweet rolls are created with flour and sugar.

== Ingredients ==

=== Dough ===
* [[Cookbook:Milk|Milk]], warm
* Active dry [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], room temperature
* 2½ [[Cookbook:Tbsp|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]], softened
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 pinch [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

=== Assembly ===
* 16 tbsp (8 [[Cookbook:Oz|oz]]) butter, softened
* 1 cup sugar
* 2 tbsp ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==

==== Dough ====
# Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk. Stir in the sugar, and let it sit for 5 minutes to activate the yeast.
# Combine the egg, 2½ tbsp sugar, and softened butter until smooth. Mix in the milk mixture.
# Combine the flour and salt. Gradually stir this dry mixture into the wet mixture until it forms a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the dough for at least 5 minutes until it is smooth, stretchy, and no longer sticky. If it is still sticky, add a little more flour. If it is too dry, add a little bit of warm water.
# Cover the dough in the bowl, and let rest for 5 minutes to make it more controllable because it becomes too soft and flexible to roll into the proper cylindrical shape.

==== Assembly ====
# Place the dough on a lightly floured surface, and roll it out into a flat rectangle. Lightly dust the dough if needed to prevent sticking.
# Spread the softened butter in a thin layer over the dough. Combine the sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle it evenly over the butter.
# Roll up the dough rectangle like a mat so you get a cylindrical log.
# Cut the log into [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]] a few inches thick. Arrange the slices cut-side up in a [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 350°F until it turns golden brown.
# Cool slightly and serve warm.
